name: Alertas de Nodos Correlacionadas (EMA vs Actuador)

parameters.query:
WITH EmaLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
EmaPrev AS (
  SELECT status AS prev_status, timestamp AS prev_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" 
  WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A' 
    AND timestamp < (SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs)
    AND status != (SELECT current_status FROM EmaLogs)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
EmaCycleStart AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS cycle_start_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog"
  WHERE device = 'Weather_Station_ZONA_A'
    AND status IN ('ONLINE', 'SLEEP')
  ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 1
),
ActLogs AS (
  SELECT status AS current_status, timestamp AS current_timestamp
  FROM "DeviceLog" WHERE device = 'Actuator_Controller'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
ActOfflineDuration AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM ActLogs) = 'OFFLINE' 
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - (SELECT current_timestamp FROM ActLogs)))::integer
      ELSE 0 
    END AS actuator_offline_seconds
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT current_status FROM EmaLogs) AS ema_current_status,
  (SELECT current_timestamp FROM EmaLogs) AS ema_current_time,
  (SELECT prev_status FROM EmaPrev) AS ema_prev_status,
  (SELECT prev_timestamp FROM EmaPrev) AS ema_prev_time,
  (SELECT cycle_start_timestamp FROM EmaCycleStart) AS ema_cycle_start_time,
  (SELECT current_status FROM ActLogs) AS act_current_status,
  (SELECT current_timestamp FROM ActLogs) AS act_current_time,
  (SELECT actuator_offline_seconds FROM ActOfflineDuration) AS act_offline_seconds;
